task: Prevent scripts/airgap/lib/push-security-db.sh from downgrading a newer Harbor mirror DB with an older bundle DB, update README/alert descriptions, and add R380 (#658).

events.summary: Scope: add freshness comparison and downgrade guard to push-security-db.sh for all artifacts in promoted/manifest.json (trivy-db, trivy-java-db, trivy-checks) with --allow-downgrade / AIRGAP_SECURITY_DB_ALLOW_DOWNGRADE=1 escape hatch; update scripts/airgap/README.md and TrivyServerDbRedownloading description in gitops/resources/prometheus-alerts.yaml; add R380, lessons-log row, and trace. Left alone: trivy-operator.yaml workloads, CronJobs/RBAC, alert expr/thresholds, and live cluster/Harbor state.

Inspected live Harbor (harbor.local.narwhal.internal) and upstream ghcr.io OCI manifests via skopeo inspect --raw (read-only): trivy-db:2, trivy-java-db:1, and trivy-checks:1 all carry top-level annotations['org.opencontainers.image.created'] (e.g. 2026-11-19T01:14:01Z for trivy-db:2, 2026-11-19T00:59:45Z for trivy-java-db:1), whereas push-security-db.sh previously called skopeo copy unconditionally without inspecting mirror freshness.

D-SECDB-NO-DOWNGRADE: push-security-db.sh preflight-inspects every promoted artifact (local oci: and remote docker://) via skopeo inspect --raw --authfile before copying any artifact: aborts nonzero with 0 copies if any bundle artifact is older than the mirror, skips equal timestamps (exit 0), pushes when mirror/repo is absent, fails closed when mirror is unreachable or lacks org.opencontainers.image.created, and allows override only via --allow-downgrade or AIRGAP_SECURITY_DB_ALLOW_DOWNGRADE=1. Updated README/alert description and added R380.
